description: This file defines the React context and hooks for authentication management within the gym management system's frontend application. It provides methods for signing in with email and Google OAuth, sign out, and access to user session data, encapsulated in a React context.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React component that provides authentication context to its children, manages session state and handles login/logout actions.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access the authentication context, providing session, user info, and auth functions.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Custom hook to derive user role from session's user metadata.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias for useAuth, maintained for backward compatibility.
